name: Armor
note: Sets AC to 6 (never worsens it); not cumulative with the shield spell. Ends when cumulative damage taken exceeds 8 + level; the armor does not absorb that damage.

name: Chill Touch
note: Touch attack. A failed save also costs 1 Strength (1 point back per hour); undead are turned instead of damaged. Only the damage is modelled.

name: Chromatic Orb
note: Orb colour = caster level (white 1 .. black 9); damage is for the best colour available. Violet (8) and black (9) deal no damage but petrify/kill. Colour special powers are not modelled. Thrown: +3/+2/+1 to hit at under 10/20/30 yards.

name: Color Spray
note: Affects 1d6 creatures by Hit Dice: lower or equal to caster level are unconscious 2d4 rounds, 1-2 above are blinded 1d4 rounds, others are stunned; saves per the text.

name: Enlarge
note: Damage rolls grow proportionally with size: multiplier = 100% + 10% per caster level, result rounded up. Hit points, AC, attack rolls and Strength/class/magic bonuses are unchanged. Unwilling targets save to negate. Reverse spell: reduce.

name: Friends
note: +2d4 Charisma for reaction checks of intelligent creatures in a 60-ft radius.

name: Magic Missile
note: Each missile 1d4+1; one missile at level 1, +1 per two further levels, max 5 (level 9). Never misses; may be split between targets.

name: Protection From Evil
note: Evil (or evilly enchanted) attackers -2 to hit and the bearer saves +2 against their attacks; also blocks possession/mental control and bodily contact from summoned or extraplanar creatures. Ends if the bearer attacks the blocked creature in melee.
condition: attacks and saves against evil creatures

name: Shield
note: Blocks magic missile entirely. AC 2 vs hurled missiles, 3 vs device-propelled missiles, 4 vs everything else; +1 to saves against frontal attacks. Only for attacks coming from the front.
condition: attacks originating from in front of the caster

name: Shocking Grasp
note: Touch attack; the charge stays for 1 round per level or until discharged.

name: Sleep
note: Affects 2d4 Hit Dice of creatures (none with 4+3 HD or more), weakest first; no save.

name: Blindness
note: Until dispelled or removed by the caster; cure spells do not work. Blinded creature -4 to attack, opponents +4 to hit it.

name: Blur
note: Attacks against the caster: -4 on the first attempt, -2 on every later attempt; +1 to saves against direct magical attacks.
condition: save bonus applies to direct magical attacks only

name: Flaming Sphere
note: 2d4 fire to creatures in contact (save negates); those within 5 ft also take 1d4 heat (save negates), not modelled. Sphere rolls 30 ft/round.

name: Glitterdust
note: Failed save: blinded (-4 to attack, saves and AC) for 1d4+1 rounds; outlines invisible creatures. Not modelled.

name: Irritation
note: Itching: AC worse by 4 and -2 to attack for 3 rounds; rash: -4 Charisma/-2 Dexterity. Not modelled.

name: Melf's Acid Arrow
note: Hits as a fighter of the caster's level (no range modifiers). 2d4 acid per round; the acid lasts 1 round plus 1 per three levels. Saving throws only for items.

name: Mirror Image
note: 1d4 images plus 1 per three levels, max 8. Each image vanishes when an attack is aimed at it.

name: Pyrotechnics
note: Fireworks blind 1d4+1 rounds; smoke imposes -2 to combat rolls and AC. Not modelled.

name: Ray of Enfeeblement
note: Debuff: humanoids man-size or smaller drop to Strength 5 (-2 attack, -1 damage); others -2 attack and -1 per damage die. Not modelled.

name: Shatter
note: Damages crystalline creatures 1d6 per level (max 6d6). Not modelled.

name: Spectral Hand
note: +2 to the touch attack roll when delivering touch spells. Not modelled.

name: Strength
note: Strength gain by class group (a bard is a rogue: 1d6). Never confers 19 or more; not cumulative with other Strength magic. A warrior with 18 Strength instead adds 10%-80% to the exceptional roll (not modelled). Creatures with no Strength score get +1 to attack and damage.

name: Summon Swarm
note: Swarm doing 1d4 + 1 per three levels each round (save negates, 1 point if defending only). Not modelled.

name: Tasha's Uncontrollable Hideous Laughter
note: Victim loses 2 Strength (or -2 to attack and damage) after the first round of laughter. Not modelled.

name: Explosive Runes
note: Trap on a written work: 6d4+6 to the reader, no save (the reader may only be spared if the caster is the reader).

name: Flame Arrow
note: Bolt version: 1d6 piercing + 4d6 fire per bolt, one bolt per five levels (half the fire damage on a save). The alternative version only adds 1 fire damage to normal arrows or bolts and is not modelled.

name: Haste
note: Up to caster-level creatures in a 40-ft cube get double movement and attacks and -2 initiative. Spellcasting is not sped up. Ages each recipient 1 year. Negates slow; not cumulative.

name: Melf's Minute Meteors
note: One 1d4 globe per caster level, +2 to hit, no range penalty; five per round or one per round. Misses deal 1 to creatures within 3 ft.

name: Protection From Evil, 10' Radius
note: As protection from evil, but covers a 10-ft radius around the creature touched; protected creatures break the warding against enchanted or summoned monsters by meleeing them.
condition: attacks and saves against evil creatures

name: Protection From Normal Missiles
note: Invulnerable to normal missiles; large or magical missiles lose 1 per damage die. Not modelled.

name: Slow
note: Up to caster-level creatures in a 40-ft cube. Half movement and attacks, +4 AC (worse), -4 to attack, Dexterity combat bonuses negated. Saves against the spell take -4. Negates haste.

name: Vampiric Touch
note: Touch attack. Drains 1d6 per two levels (max 6d6) and heals the caster by that many (excess as temporary hit points, lost first). Ends on a successful touch or after one turn.

name: Contagion
note: Debuff: Str/Dex/Cha -2 and -2 to attack until cured. Not modelled.

name: Dig
note: 4d6 damage to earth-bound creatures; excavation. Not modelled.

name: Emotion
note: Picks one of eight emotions (e.g. courage: +1 attack, +3 damage, +5 hp; hope +2). Not modelled.

name: Enchanted Weapon
note: Gives one large or two small weapons +1 to attack and damage rolls (the weapon is treated as magical).

name: Evard's Black Tentacles
note: Area of tentacles attacking creatures every round. Not modelled.

name: Fire Shield
note: Personal shield returning damage to melee attackers and changing fire/cold saves. Not modelled.

name: Ice Storm
note: Hail version: 3d10 in a 40-ft-diameter area for one round. The alternative sleet version blinds and slows instead of dealing damage.

name: Improved Invisibility
note: Attacks against the creature take -4 and its saves get +4. The recipient can attack, shoot and cast and stay unseen.

name: Improved Strength
note: Strength gain by class group with higher caps (a bard is a rogue: 1d6+4, max 23). Each exceptional-Strength bracket counts as one point. When it ends the recipient must rest for 1d3 full turns.

name: Shout
note: Also deafens for 2d6 rounds; a save negates the deafness and halves the damage.

name: Stoneskin
note: Blocks 1d4 attacks plus 1 per two caster levels, physical or magical; magical effects still apply their normal effects. Not cumulative with itself.

name: Wall of Fire
note: Heat 2d4 within 10 ft / 1d4 within 20 ft; 2d6+level to anything passing through. Not modelled.

name: Wall of Ice
note: Breaking through costs 2 damage per inch of thickness; ice-storm mode. Not modelled.

name: Bigby's Interposing Hand
note: Force hand imposing -10 to enemy attack/obstructing. Not modelled.

name: Cloudkill
note: Kills creatures under 4+1 HD; save or die up to 6 HD; 1d10 per round above that. Not modelled.

name: Cone of Cold
note: 1d4+1 per level, no stated cap.

name: Dream
note: Nightmare variant deals 1d10 damage. Not modelled.

name: Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound
note: Phantom dog bites 3d6 as a 10 HD monster. Not modelled.

name: Bigby's Forceful Hand
note: Force hand pushing opponents. Not modelled.

name: Chain Lightning
note: First strike only. The bolt then arcs to up to (level - 1) further targets, each jump 1d6 weaker; arcs are not modelled.

name: Death Fog
note: Acidic solid fog damaging creatures by exposure time. Not modelled.

name: Demishadow Magic
note: Quasi-real evocations at 40% damage. Not modelled.

name: Eyebite
note: Gaze effects (fear, sicken, ...) chosen at casting. Not modelled.

name: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere
note: Ray of cold 1d4+2 per level or other modes. Not modelled.

name: Tenser's Transformation
note: Caster hit points double (damage hits the extra points first, later damage doubled), AC 4 better, fights as a fighter of the same level with dagger (2 attacks, +2 damage) or staff (+2 to hit and damage).

name: Transmute Water to Dust
note: Living creatures take 1d6 per level (half on a save). Not modelled.

name: Bigby's Grasping Hand
note: Force hand grappling for damage by round. Not modelled.

name: Delayed Blast Fireball
note: Fireball with +1 per die; the seed text only says "otherwise the same as fireball" (max 10d6); the printed PHB cap is 20d6. Blast delayed up to 5 rounds.

name: Duo-Dimension
note: Cannot be hit when turned sideways; double damage when visible. Not modelled.

name: Finger of Death
note: Kills on a failed save; 2d8+1 damage on a save. Not modelled.

name: Mordenkainen's Sword
note: Force sword attacking as a fighter of half level: 5d4 vs man-size, 5d6 vs larger. Not modelled.

name: Prismatic Spray
note: Seven rays with different damage and effects. Not modelled.

name: Spell Turning
note: Rebounds spells onto the original caster. Not modelled.

name: Bigby's Clenched Fist
note: Force fist striking one opponent per round for damage. Not modelled.

name: Incendiary Cloud
note: Rounds 3/4/5: 1d2 / 1d4 / 1d2 per caster level fire damage; save to halve. Not modelled.

name: Otto's Irresistible Dance
note: Dancing victim: AC worse by 4, saves at -10, cannot attack. Not modelled.

name: Prismatic Wall
note: Layered colours with damage (e.g. 20/40/80 points) and effects. Not modelled.

name: Bigby's Crushing Hand
note: Force hand constricting for damage each round. Not modelled.

name: Meteor Swarm
note: Either 4 spheres of 10d4 or 8 spheres of 5d4, each bursting as a fireball (half on a save); a creature in the straight-line path takes the full effect without a save. Only the large-sphere option is modelled.

name: Prismatic Sphere
note: Layered colours with large damage and effects. Not modelled.
